finding.sequence_description: Replay a SAML assertion that includes <OneTimeUse/> by re-submitting the exact same Assertion/@ID in a second SP-initiated flow; second submission must be rejected.
finding.description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_onetimeuse_2_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attacker_onetimeuse_2_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Dex accepted a replayed OneTimeUse SAML assertion (same Assertion ID used twice) — replay protection missing or ineffective.

sequence.description: Replay a SAML assertion that includes <OneTimeUse/> by re-submitting the exact same Assertion/@ID in a second SP-initiated flow; second submission must be rejected.
sequence.invariant_hypothesis: I2: A SAML assertion marked OneTimeUse must not be accepted more than once; replaying the same Assertion ID should be rejected on the second attempt.

oracle_checks.violation_description: Control failed: initial OneTimeUse assertion was not accepted; cannot evaluate replay protection.
Dex accepted a replayed OneTimeUse SAML assertion (same Assertion ID used twice) — replay protection missing or ineffective.

finding.sequence_description: Replay the exact same SAMLResponse+RelayState POST twice (same SP-initiated flow context) to test whether Dex enforces one-time consumption of the callback artifact.
finding.description:
Assertion FAILED: user_victim_firstpost_login_status == 200 AND user_attacker_repost_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: (user_victim_firstpost_login_status=200 == 200 → True) AND (user_attacker_repost_login_status=200 >= 400 → False)
Implication: Dex accepted the same SAMLResponse+RelayState POST twice; callback artifact was reusable (replay) when it should be single-use.

sequence.description: Replay the exact same SAMLResponse+RelayState POST twice (same SP-initiated flow context) to test whether Dex enforces one-time consumption of the callback artifact.
sequence.invariant_hypothesis: I2: A SAML callback artifact (SAMLResponse bound to RelayState/InResponseTo) must be single-use; re-posting the same response for the same flow must be rejected.

oracle_checks.violation_description: Dex accepted the same SAMLResponse+RelayState POST twice; callback artifact was reusable (replay) when it should be single-use.

finding.sequence_description: Replay a SAML assertion with the same Assertion/@ID but with Conditions omitted (remove_conditions=true) to probe whether Dex relies on Conditions for replay/freshness enforcement instead of persistent assertion ID tracking.
finding.description:
Assertion FAILED: user_replay_attempt_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_replay_attempt_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Dex accepted a replayed SAML assertion (same Assertion/@ID) when Conditions were omitted; replay/freshness enforcement is bypassable.

sequence.description: Replay a SAML assertion with the same Assertion/@ID but with Conditions omitted (remove_conditions=true) to probe whether Dex relies on Conditions for replay/freshness enforcement instead of persistent assertion ID tracking.
sequence.invariant_hypothesis: I2: A SAML assertion must not be accepted more than once even if the attacker omits the <Conditions> element; replay detection should be based on assertion identifiers and/or stored state, not on optional Conditions.

oracle_checks.violation_description: Control SAML login (first use) did not succeed; cannot evaluate replay behavior.
Dex accepted a replayed SAML assertion (same Assertion/@ID) when Conditions were omitted; replay/freshness enforcement is bypassable.

finding.sequence_description: I3 cross-step coherence: reuse the same SP-initiated RelayState and submit two different SAMLResponses for the same initiated flow (double-submit). Dex should treat the flow as single-use and reject the second callback.
finding.description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_second_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attacker_second_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Dex accepted a second SAML callback submission for the same SP-initiated RelayState (flow not atomic/single-use) — potential cross-step splicing/double-submit.

sequence.description: I3 cross-step coherence: reuse the same SP-initiated RelayState and submit two different SAMLResponses for the same initiated flow (double-submit). Dex should treat the flow as single-use and reject the second callback.
sequence.invariant_hypothesis: I3: An SP-initiated SAML auth flow must be atomic and single-use; once a RelayState/InResponseTo pair is consumed, subsequent saml_login submissions for the same initiated flow must be rejected (no double-submit).

oracle_checks.violation_description: Dex accepted a second SAML callback submission for the same SP-initiated RelayState (flow not atomic/single-use) — potential cross-step splicing/double-submit.

finding.sequence_description: SAML assertion missing <Conditions> (no audience/time bounds) should be rejected; if accepted, Dex grants a session without upstream intent constraints.
finding.description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_nocond_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attacker_nocond_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Dex accepted a SAML assertion without <Conditions>, granting a session without upstream audience/time constraints (over-grant beyond UpstreamIntent ∩ BrokerPolicy).

sequence.description: SAML assertion missing <Conditions> (no audience/time bounds) should be rejected; if accepted, Dex grants a session without upstream intent constraints.
sequence.invariant_hypothesis: I5: Dex must not grant an authenticated session when the SAML assertion omits Conditions (removing audience/time constraints), because EffectivePerms would exceed UpstreamIntent ∩ BrokerPolicy.

oracle_checks.violation_description: Dex accepted a SAML assertion without <Conditions>, granting a session without upstream audience/time constraints (over-grant beyond UpstreamIntent ∩ BrokerPolicy).
Dex issued/retained a usable session after accepting a SAML assertion without <Conditions>.
